# clear_setting { #crossrepo.config.clear_setting }

```python
crossrepo.config.clear_setting(text, key)
```

Take one setting out of a configuration file, so its default applies again.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

<code>[**text**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[str](`str`)]{.parameter-annotation}</code>

:   Content of the file.

<code>[**key**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[str](`str`)]{.parameter-annotation}</code>

:   Setting to remove.

## Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

<code>[]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[str](`str`)]{.parameter-annotation}</code>

:   The file without it. Unchanged when it was not there, a setting left at its default and a setting never written being the same thing.
